ce_bugs.text: app/serializers/embedding_serializer.rb:3 — has_many ... embed: :ids` without `include: true` emits only `embeddable_host_ids` and no sideloaded root array, so the store hydrates an array of `undefined` and the admin list renders empty.

app/models/embeddable_host.rb:2 — Validation regex allows an optional `:port`, but `record_for_host` compares against `uri.host` which strips the port, so any host entered with a port can never match a referer.

app/models/embeddable_host.rb:2 — Regex `[a-z]{2,5}` TLD limit rejects legitimate hosts (.museum, .software, localhost, IP addresses) that the old free-form site setting allowed; migrated rows survive but can never be re-saved.

app/models/embeddable_host.rb:17 — No uniqueness validation or unique index on host; duplicates are allowed and `.first` without ORDER BY picks a nondeterministic row, so embedded topics land in a random category.

app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/store.js.es6:198 — In the `_ids` branch unresolved ids map to `undefined` and the original `_ids` key is deleted unconditionally, silently losing the data (`hydrated || []` is dead since map always returns an array).

app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6:26 — edit` seeds `categoryId` from `host.category.id`; when hydration failed to resolve the category this is undefined, and saving then sends a blank category_id which the server silently rewrites to uncategorized.

app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:24 — Blank category_id is silently coerced to uncategorized instead of rejected, so a client-side ordering/hydration failure quietly reassigns an existing host's category.

app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6:44 — destroyRecord()` has no `.catch`, so a failed delete silently leaves the row in place with an unhandled rejection and no user feedback.
app/models/topic.rb:869 — expandable_first_post?` dropped the host-configured check entirely rather than checking `EmbeddableHost.exists?`, changing behavior on sites with no embeddable hosts.
